comparison_count_reading_open_item.text: The contract's LPF-CAL-B note computes its exact binomial band from '20 x 4 x 1 = 80 comparisons at that cell'. STAT-LPF-1 has four members, but one of them (STAT-KS2-CAL) is NON-CERTIFYING and is not computed in the calibration, while STAT-RATE-u spans five frozen Bsm rungs, so the number of comparisons actually available per replicate is seven, not four. BOTH READINGS ARE RECORDED AND NEITHER IS RESOLVED HERE. Per ATS-LPF-1 clause 4 this is routed to TASK-20260801-054; the cut itself is RR-LPF-1's to freeze and this driver freezes none.
